Command.name: Active Schedule Enable Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued by a node when the schedule state for a target has been altered from any source, unless the schedule is enabled as the result of a successful Daily Repeating Schedule Set or Year Day Schedule Set.

Command.name: Active Schedule Year Day Schedule Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued by a node when schedule data has been altered from any source.

Command.name: Active Schedule Daily Repeating Schedule Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued by a node when schedule data has been altered from any source.

Command.name: Barrier Operator Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued by a node when the barrier has finished a transition (e.g. from Open to Close) and reached a final state

Command.name: Barrier Operator Event Signaling Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when a subsystem state has changed.

Command.name: Battery Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued by a node in two different cases: periodically to report the current battery level where the frequency is up to the implementation, and when its battery becomes low and the end user needs to reload or replace the battery. The Battery Level field MUST be set to 0xFF to indicate a low battery warning.

Command.name: Central Scene Notification
Command.description: This command MUST be issued by a node when a user actuated a Scene Notification button/method on the supporting node.

Command.name: Central Scene Configuration Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued by a node when its Central Scene Configuration has changed.

Command.name: Clock Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when the clock setting has been modified.

Command.name: Device Reset Locally Notification
Command.description: This command MUST be issued by a node when it has been locally or manually reset to factory default.

Command.name: Door Lock Operation Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued by a node when it has completed a lock/unlock operation initiated locally.

Command.name: Door Lock Configuration Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued by when the Door Lock configuration has changed.

Command.name: Entry Control Notification
Command.description: This command MUST be issued by a node when a user input has exceeded key cache size or key cache timeout.

Command.name: Indicator Report
Command.description: This command SHOULD be issued when an indicator property has changed.

Command.name: Irrigation System Status Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when a system error has occured.

Command.name: Meter Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued periodically to report the current Meter reading. The sending frequency is up to the implementation. It is RECOMMENDED to implement a minimum reporting interval (for example, every 70 minutes) and send additional reports when a measurement variation occurred. A node supporting multiple meter types MUST advertise readings for all of the supported types via the Lifeline Group. Each meter type MAY have a different timing mechanism for reporting its readings.

Command.name: Notification Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued by Push nodes every time a new event is detected or when a state variable has changed state.

Command.name: Sensor Multilevel Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued periodically to report the current Multilevel sensor reading. The sending frequency is up to the implementation. It is RECOMMENDED to implement a minimum reporting interval (for example, every 70 minutes) and send additional reports when a measurement variation occurred. A node supporting multiple sensor types MUST advertise readings for all of the supported types via the Lifeline Group. Each sensor type MAY have a different timing mechanism for reporting its readings.

Command.name: Sound Switch Configuration Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when volume or default tone has changed.

Command.name: Sound Switch Tone Play Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when a tone has started playing.

Command.name: Switch Binary Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when the binary switch value has changed (and reached a final state)

Command.name: Switch Color Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when a color component level has changed.

Command.name: Switch Multilevel Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when the multilevel switch value has changed (and reached a final state)

Command.name: Thermostat Mode Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when the Thermostat Mode has changed.

Command.name: Thermostat Setback Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when the Thermostat Setback has changed.

Command.name: Thermostat Setpoint Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when the Thermostat Setpoint setting has changed.

Command.name: User Code Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when a User Code record is modified.

Command.name: Users Number Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when the number of supported User Code CC Users (i.e. User Codes) has changed via migration.

Command.name: User Code Keypad Mode Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when the Keypad Mode has been modified.

Command.name: Admin Code Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when the Admin Code has been modified.

Command.name: Extended User Code Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when a User Code record with user identifier > 255 has been modified.

Command.name: User Capabilities Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when the number of supported User Credential CC Users has changed via migration.

Command.name: User Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when a User Credential - User record is modified.

Command.name: Credential Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when a User Credential - Credential record is modified.

Command.name: User Credential Association Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when an existing credential is successfully reassigned to another user.

Command.name: Admin Pin Code Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when the admin code has been modified.

Command.name: Key Locker Entry Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when a key locker entry has been modified.

Command.name: Migration Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when a migration operation changes state – for instance, if an operation starts, completes or is no longer valid.

Command.name: Window Covering Report
Command.description: This command MUST be issued when a Parameter ID has changed value.
